title: Red Records and the Modern masters
summary: The Biharis gave him two masters that he released on his own label with his wife.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Anyhow, now Mary Lou and I have our little label called Red Records. This came about because Modern records, or the Biharis, saw fit to give me two masters that I had recorded for them some years ago, one Red Callender Speaks Low and Swingin' Sweet. So we released Callender Speaks Low and we advertised it in the Tuba Generals Journal and some other publications, and we get orders from all over the world for this because it's really a collectors' item. You have that, no doubt.
Well, then, I owe you two records. Leonard did the liner notes on the new Collectors Item, and they're very complimentary.
